content.title: Forest Light-Route Loop | Blackout, Carrier Passage and Relighting
content.summary: A ferry reveals and closes a glowing forest route loop. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One route and one observer anchor both states. + Baseline lights change monotonically before carrier arrival. + The carrier follows the revealed route exactly once. + Interior carrier light contrasts with the exterior state. + The final relighting restores the opening geography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult night ranger beside a lantern on a forest path where many tree alcoves glow amber. Gather blue mist and reveal one small electric ferry approaching with two white lamps. As it departs, relight the tree alcoves in reverse order and hold the same ranger beside the original lantern.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

invariants.rule: One route and one observer anchor both states.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One route and one observer anchor both states."

invariants.rule: Baseline lights change monotonically before carrier arrival.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Baseline lights change monotonically before carrier arrival."

invariants.rule: The carrier follows the revealed route exactly once.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The carrier follows the revealed route exactly once."

invariants.rule: Interior carrier light contrasts with the exterior state.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Interior carrier light contrasts with the exterior state."

invariants.rule: The final relighting restores the opening geography.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final relighting restores the opening geography."
